title: Amprobe Recalls Clamp Meters Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The meters can fail to give an appropriate voltage reading, resulting in the operator believing the electrical power is off, which can pose a risk of shock, electrocution, or thermal burn hazard. Units: About 70,000.

title: Children's Mood Necklaces Recalled by Rhode Island Novelty Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 47,000.

title: Children's Necklaces Sold Exclusively at Claire's Stores Recalled Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled necklaces contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 58,000.

title: Gevalia Recalls Kaffe Combo Coffeemakers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The heating element can melt the plastic outer shell, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 21,000.

title: Children's Necklaces Sold Exclusively at Accessories Palace Recalled by United Imports Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 3,600.

title: Toys "R" Us Recalls "Elite Operations" Toy Sets Due to Lead and Laceration Hazards
summary: These toys contain high levels of lead in the paint, which is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Also, the toys have sharp points, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 128,700.

title: Tri-Star International Recalls Children's Stationery Sets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The children's stationery set contains a razor blade cutter with a sharp edge, posing a laceration hazard to young children. Units: About 360.

title: Cobmex Inc. Recalls Youth Jackets with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The recalled jackets have drawstrings in the hood and waist, or only at the waist. Children can get entangled and strangle in drawstrings that can catch on playground equipment, fences or tree branches. Units: About 16,000.

title: Dollar Stop Plus Recalls Extension Cords for Fire, Shock, Electrocution Hazards
summary: These extension cords have undersized wiring, and fail to connect properly at the plug and receptacle ends. This poses fire, shock and electrocution hazards to consumers. Units: About 40.

title: H & M Recalls Boys' Jackets Due to Choking, Poisoning Hazards
summary: The attached compass on these jackets can break, posing a choking hazard for young children. Additionally, the liquid mineral oil inside the compass can be harmful if swallowed. Units: About 2,700.

title: Nordstrom Recalls Children's Flannel Lounge Pants Due to Burn Hazard
summary: These lounge pants are 100 percent cotton and fail to meet the children's sleepwear flammability standards, posing a risk of burn injury to children. These garments were not labeled or marketed as sleepwear, but because they are children's loungewear, they must meet the children's sleepwear flammabi

title: Discount School Supply Recalls Children's Two-Sided Easels Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The paint on the chalkboard side of the recalled easels contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 2,500.

title: One World Technologies Recalls Throat Plates Sold with Ryobi Router Tables Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The throat plates do not securely snap into the router's table top bit opening. The throat plate can come loose during operation and be ejected from the table top, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 100,000.

title: Weber-Stephen Products Recalls Gas Grills Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The gas hose attached to the side burner of the grill can crack or break off during shipping, causing it to leak gas when in use, which poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: Venmar Ventilation Inc. Recalls Heat Recovery Ventilators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The motors in these units can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 32,000.

title: Dynacraft Recalls Bicycles Sold Exclusively at Target Due to Frame Failure
summary: The bicycle frame can crack while in use, causing the rider to lose control and suffer injuries from a fall or collision. Units: About 32,000.

title: Inflator Pumps Recalled By Stearns Inc. Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The inflator pumps can explode during use, ejecting sharp plastic parts and posing a serious laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400.

title: Regent Products Corp. Recalls Stuffed Ball Toys Due to Lead Hazard
summary: The stuffed balls contain lead paint, which is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 7,200.

title: Baby Trend Recalls Back Pack Carriers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stitching on the strap of the carrier can loosen or detach, causing the carrier to shift, posing a fall hazard to young children. Units: About 4,000.

title: Estes-Cox Radio Control Airplanes with Lithium Polymer Batteries Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: The airplanes can overheat while recharging the battery, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 66,000.

title: QVC Inc. Recalls "Quacker Factory" Robes for Burn Hazard
summary: The robes fail to meet Federal flammability requirements. Should the robe come in contact with an ignition source, such as a stove burner, candle flame or cigarette lighter, it could catch fire and possibly cause serious burns to consumers. Units: About 15,000.

title: Universal Engineering Recalls Clamps for Motocross Motorcycles Due to Fork Separation Hazard
summary: The radius triple clamps on these motorcycles can crack during operation, posing a risk that the fork of the bike could separate and result in serious injury or death to the rider. Units: About 48.

title: Digital Security Controls Recalls Smoke Detectors that Could Fail to Warn of a Fire
summary: These smoke detectors could fail to reliably detect smoke during a fire. Units: About 32,000.

title: Infantino Recalls Infant Sling Carriers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic slider on the fabric strap can break. This can cause the strap supporting the carrier to release and infants to fall out of the carrier. Units: About 32,000.

title: Home Decorators Collection Recalls Wall Sconces Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: A missing back plate exposes consumers to live wires, posing a risk of electrical shock to consumers changing the light bulb. Units: About 900.

title: Maytag® and Samsung™ Brand Front Loading Washing Machines Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Water leakage onto the electrical connections to the washing machine's thermal sensor could cause an electrical short and ignite a circuit board, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 250,000 Maytag-brand units and about 20,000 Samsung-brand units.

title: American Suzuki Motor Corp. Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The bushing pivot mount boss on the left and right suspension arm may not have been welded completely and could break off during riding. If this occurs, the rider could lose control of the ATV and crash, posing risk of serious injury or death. Units: About 3,500.

title: Casio® Inc. Announces Recall of Electronic Keyboards Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled keyboards can overheat when in use, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 12,000.

title: Hanna Andersson Recalls Children's Loungewear Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled garments fail to meet the children's sleepwear flammability standards. The Crossover Tee and Lounge Pant sets were marketed as loungewear. title: Laars Heating Systems Recalls Gas Boilers and Water Heaters Due to Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
summary: Internal black plastic venting components in the gas boilers and water heaters can crack and leak flue gases, including carbon monoxide (CO), posing a risk of CO poisoning. Units: About 2,100.
